CURRENT PREVIEW

What this website does.

Website operator

This website is being prepared for HeyDock. The registered office, company number and privacy contact must be added before a public commercial launch.

Forms and downloads

The enquiry builder processes entries within your browser to generate a text brief. It does not send those entries to HeyDock or save them in local storage. If you download a brief, the file is saved on your device.

Hosting and access

This private preview uses ChatGPT Sites hosting and sign-in. The platform may process access, account and technical information under its own policies. The page itself does not add advertising trackers or analytics scripts.

Future enquiry processing

Before a live form is connected, this notice must be updated with the actual contact details, purposes, lawful basis, recipients, retention periods, relevant international transfers and rights process.

Cookies and browser storage

The website code does not set tracking cookies or persist form entries. Platform authentication may use its own cookies. Catalogue filters operate within the current page.
